tests.name: ALYNE Service Card on Home Page
tests.details: ALYNE card visible with gradient background (cyan-blue-purple), 'Kids Health & Care' subtitle, 'Get Started' button

tests.name: ALYNE Page - Unauthenticated
tests.details: Shows 'Welcome to ALYNE', 'Kids Health & Care Portal', login prompt, 'Go to Login' button

tests.name: ALYNE Page - Gradient Background
tests.details: Beautiful gradient from sky-50 via purple-50 to pink-50

alyne_service_card.details: ALYNE card visible on home page with gradient background, positioned alongside DiaGyn, Proton, Orange Pharmacy, Evara, Glydex

alyne_page_unauthenticated.details: Shows login prompt with 'Welcome to ALYNE', 'Kids Health & Care Portal', 'Go to Login' button

regions_config.details: GET /api/alyne/config/regions returns India (IAP schedule) and USA (CDC schedule) with proper id_fields

child_profile_management.details: Full CRUD for child profiles with multi-child support from Day 1. Auto-generates vaccination schedule on creation.

vaccination_schedule.details: Auto-generated based on DOB and region. India uses IAP schedule (41 vaccines), USA uses CDC schedule. Tracks due/overdue/upcoming status.

growth_tracking.details: Records height, weight, head circumference with WHO percentile calculation. Returns percentile range and status (normal/below_normal/above_normal).

health_log.details: Supports symptom, doctor_visit, medication, note types with full details

document_storage.details: Base64 encoded document upload with types: immunization_record, medical_report, school_form, prescription, other

dashboard_summary.details: Returns child info, vaccination stats, latest growth, upcoming reminders, recent health logs, document count

reminders.details: Create reminders for vaccination, medication, appointment, checkup with due_date, due_time, repeat options

mocked_data.none: All APIs are fully functional with MongoDB persistence

critical_code_review_comments: ALYNE module fully implemented with all required features
Backend routes properly structured in /app/backend/routes/alyne.py (810 lines)
Frontend page at /app/frontend/src/pages/Alyne.js with Dashboard, Vaccinations, Growth, Documents, Health Log tabs
